categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
# Goal
Beat the level

# Timing
* Use In-game timer
* Do not round your time, just leave off the last digit.

# Requirements
* Video proof is required (You can record your replays)
* Video must show full run and the timer screen

# Gameplay Restrictions
* Use of spectator glitch is not allowed

categories.name: All Courses
categories.rules:
# Goal
Complete All Levels (Trials not included)

# Timing
* Time starts on first movement and ends when you complete the last level.

# Requirements
* Runs must be real time (No pausing the timer)
* Runs must be single segment 
* Video proof is required

# Gameplay Restrictions
* Use of spectator glitch is not allowed

categories.name: All Checkpoints
categories.rules:
# Goal
Beat All levels While also hitting every visible checkpoint on each level. (Trials not included)

# Timing
* Time starts on first movement and ends on completion of the last level

# Requirements
* Runs must be real time (No pausing the timer)
* Runs must be single segment 
* Video proof is required

# Gameplay Restrictions
* Must hit every checkpoint on every level
* Use of spectator glitch is not allowed

categories.name: All Collectibles
categories.rules:
# Goal
Collect all cards, comics and pins from a new game file. 

# Timing
* Time starts on first movement and ends when you complete the last level.

# Requirements
* Runs must be real time (No pausing the timer)
* Runs must be single segment 
* Video proof is required
* Must Play off of a New File (See Guides)
* After the run you must check to see if you have all of the collectibles

# Gameplay Restrictions
* Use of spectator glitch is not allowed

categories.name: All Checkpoints
categories.rules:
# Goal
Beat the level while collecting all of the visible checkpoints. 

# Timing
* Use In-game timer
* Do not round your time, just leave off the last digit.

# Requirements
* Video proof is required, please record the run live so you we can actually see the checkpoints being collected. (Replays are likely to be rejected)
* Video must show full run and the timer screen
* Must collect all visible checkpoints

# Gameplay Restrictions
* Use of spectator glitch is not allowed

categories.name: No Abilities
categories.rules:
# Goal
Beat the level without using character Abilities.

# Timing
* Use In-game timer
* Do not round your time, just leave off the last digit.

# Requirements
* Video proof is required
* Video must show full run and the timer screen

# Gameplay Restrictions
* Using Character abilities is not allowed. These include Boost Jumping, Slide Jumping, Sludge's High Jump and Double Jumping. But gaining speed by other means is allowed, such as surf ramps. And Bhopping to maintain speed is also allowed. 
* For Pogo Trials you are not allowed to jump.(No pressing the jump button) 
* Use of spectator glitch is not allowed

# Goal
Get all 268 Stars and all of the collectibles. (All Courses, All Trials, All Buddy Levels, Cards, Comics, & Pins)

# Timing
* Time starts on first movement and ends when you complete the last level.

# Requirements
* Runs must be real time (No pausing the timer)
* Runs must be single segment 
* Video proof is required
* Must Play off of a Fresh File (See Guides)
* After the run you must check to see if all stars and cards are completed.

# Gameplay Restrictions
* Use of spectator glitch is not allowed

categories.name: All Courses (No Abilities)
categories.rules:
# Goal
Beat All levels without using any character abilities. (Trials not included)

# Timing
* Time starts on first movement and ends when you complete the last level.

# Requirements
* Runs must be real time (No pausing the timer)
* Runs must be single segment (Can't take all your best IL times and splice them together)
* Video proof is required

# Gameplay Restrictions
* Using Character abilities is not allowed. These include Boost Jumping, Slide Jumping, Sludge's High Jump and Double Jumping. But gaining speed by other means is allowed, such as surf ramps. And Bhopping to maintain speed is also allowed. 
* Use of spectator glitch is not allowed

categories.name: Old School%
categories.rules:
# Goal
Beat all school courses 

# Timing
* Time starts when you load in and ends when you beat the last level. 

# Requirements
* Runs must show the In-game timer. 
* Video proof is required

# Gameplay Restrictions
* Use of spectator glitch is not allowed

levels.name: Intro
levels.rules:
# Level Specific Rules
* Time starts the first frame that you move and ends the first frame your crosshair disappears.
* All Intro runs will be retimed by mods
